description: Calculate the WCAG contrast ratio for foreground and background colors and determine whether the pair passes for the supplied text size and weight.

background.description: Background CSS sRGB color such as white, #ffffff, rgb(), hsl(), or color(srgb ...).

foreground.description: Foreground CSS sRGB color such as white, #767676, rgb(), hsl(), or color(srgb ...).

name: check_contrast
title: Check a color pair
